A report gives this data: attendance was 90, 105 and 120 over three successive sessions. Which statement is precise and avoids overclaiming?
An application requests leave from 8 to 10 January. Which detail is essential to make the request actionable?
A slide says “The new process is faster” and lists times of 14 minutes before and 9 minutes after. Which rewrite best combines claim and evidence?
The audience includes beginners and experienced technicians. How should the speaker handle essential technical vocabulary?
A speaker loses their place after an audience question. Which preparation method best prevents the interruption from derailing the talk?
A student reports “Everyone agreed that the workshop was useful,” but only 4 of 20 respondents completed the feedback form. What is the best correction?
An email contains a vague subject, an attachment with an unclear filename, and a deadline only in the final paragraph. Which revision most improves usability?
A speaker is challenged about a statistic but is unsure of the source. What is the most credible response?
A reading passage gives one example of a benefit but does not discuss cost. Which conclusion about cost is safest?
